needed_lemma: An absolute convergence criterion for a specified abstract-polymer/Gibbs expansion, only if a valid model representation and uniform activity bound can be constructed.
unproved_interface: No polymer representation of the optimized deletion-channel information rate has been verified. The read criteria have different objects and hypotheses and do not establish capacity convergence on their own. A channel-specific representation, event/dependency structure where relevant, and uniform bounds remain unproved. C07 concerns stable, tempered continuous pair-potential gases; it supplies no deletion-channel representation. C05 is a finite repulsive lattice-gas/LLL theorem, C12 an abstract hard-core polymer criterion, and C15 a stable measurable pair-potential expansion; none supplies a deletion-channel representation or uniform activity bounds. C14 is an unverified title/DOI citation candidate; do not treat it as a validated distinct work or conflate it with C15.

unproved_interface: Conjecture 4.2/Open Problem 2 is not proved by the source. The formal dossier additionally asks for steady-state fluid scaling and an induced waiting-time law, which must not be inferred from the conjecture without proof.

needed_lemma: Renewal-reward, residual-life, branching-type polling and large-switch-over comparators under the assumptions stated by each source.
unproved_interface: Polling epochs need not be regeneration epochs under renewal input. The residual-age process and stationary-to-fluid limit exchange require new tightness and dependence arguments; adjacent heavy-traffic, branching-type, and Poisson results do not settle A007. Unread candidates in this list remain retrieval/reading leads, not theorem evidence. R13 is a canonical-reuse example of a two-queue adaptive stability criterion involving a service-time Laplace transform; it is not a large-setup or general-renewal limit result, and its W16 usage evidence is pending review.

needed_lemma: A classical stable-potential-gas example of finite- and infinite-volume virial-radius bounds from cluster-coefficient majorants, with exact constants and the analytic-continuation condition kept attached.
unproved_interface: Lebowitz–Penrose concerns pressure/density expansions of a classical gas with stability, finite Mayer integral, and (for the thermodynamic-limit continuation result) a regular analytic continuation on a bounded simply connected domain. No polymer representation, cluster coefficients, uniformity in input laws, or analytic continuation has been established for the optimized deletion-channel information rate in B051; this is a structural analogy only.
